name: NEOIX Nova Gradiska data center campus
notes: City of Nova Gradiska signed a preliminary agreement (predugovor) on 2025-12-04 with London-based NEOIX PLC for a 50 MW AI data center in the city's industrial zone; EUR 400-450m greenfield investment, 75,000 m2 land, described as the largest in Croatia; NEOIX official project page lists status 'In Development'. First-round results linked this project to Digital Realty via trade press; this round verified NEOIX as the lead developer. Construction permit not yet public; grade B.

name: EXA Infrastructure Slobodnica data center
notes: Aggregator listings (Datacenters.com, Inflect) place an EXA Infrastructure data center in Brodsko-posavska zupanija / Slobodnica; no capacity disclosed and no primary operator page found; kept as aggregate-grade lead.

name: HR-ZOO Osijek data center
developer: University Computing Centre, University of Zagreb (SRCE) / HR-ZOO
notes: Official SRCE announcement: HR-ZOO data centres opened in Split and Osijek as part of Croatia's scientific/educational cloud e-infrastructure; one of the HR-ZOO regional facilities in Osijek-Baranja County.

name: Claro Osijek data center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Claro Osijek at 0.3 MW; no primary facility page found, so treated as aggregate-grade evidence only.

name: Atos Group Osijek data center
notes: DataCenterMap lists an Atos Group Osijek data center; capacity and primary-source details not disclosed in accessible sources; aggregate-grade lead.

name: EXA Infrastructure Ilok data center
notes: Inflect aggregator lists EXA Infrastructure Ilok 1 in Croatia (Ilok is in Vukovar-Srijem County); capacity not disclosed, primary confirmation not found; aggregate-grade.

name: MCM Metachemicals / Eureka / Borovo Vukovar data center (planned)
developer: MCM Metachemicals and Machinery (Baku) with Eureka International Group Logistics and Borovo
notes: April 2026 meeting between Vukovar-Srijem deputy county prefect and representatives of Azerbaijani MCM Metachemicals and machinery, Eureka International Group Logistics (Osijek) and Borovo about building a data center in Vukovar; early-stage talks, no capacity, site or permits announced; local press only - grade C. NEW find this round (first round had no_projects for this county apart from EXA Ilok).

name: HR-ZOO Split data center
developer: University Computing Centre, University of Zagreb (SRCE) / HR-ZOO
notes: Official SRCE announcement: HR-ZOO data centre opened in Split (2022); one of the national HR-ZOO distributed e-infrastructure facilities in Split-Dalmatia County.

name: Inovapro Green AI Data Center (ZelenAI), Caporice-Trilj
notes: Inovapro is building a 'green AI data center' in the Gospodarska zona Caporice-Trilj (Split-Dalmatia), designed for AI/HPC racks up to 120 kW with direct chip cooling and dual-zone architecture, within the wider Caporice energy park (biogas/biowaste plant opened, solar and BESS phases planned); DataCenterMap lists a 3 MW planned green AI data center; construction trade press (Baustela) reports active construction; capacity is design/planning figure - grade B, verify permits for capacity confirmation.

name: Tehnoline Telekom Pula data center
notes: Official operator page advertises a data center (Datacentar) service from Pula (Bose Gumpca 49, 52100 Pula) as the local telecommunications partner for Istria and Kvarner, offering colocation/server accommodation; capacity not disclosed.

name: IPC d.d. Cakovec data center
developer: IPC d.d. Cakovec (Medimurske informacijske i komunikacijske djelatnosti)
notes: Official IPC page describes a fully equipped data center in Cakovec offering remote data storage, business continuity, colocation and server rental, with own transformer station, diesel generator with auto-start, UPS, biometric access control, motion sensors and 24/7 video surveillance; regional enterprise/colo facility in Medimurje County. NEW find this round (first round had no_projects for Medimurje).

name: Digital Realty ZAG1 Zagreb (former Altus IT)
notes: Digital Realty lists ZAG1 in Zagreb with 2 MW utility power; carrier-neutral colocation at Selska cesta 93 (former Altus IT facility acquired via Interxion); AmCham reports ZAG1 capacity expansion; alias Altus IT folded into this record per normalization rule.

name: Digital Realty ZAG2 Zagreb (Jankomir)
notes: Lider reports Digital Realty planning a new largest-in-Croatia data center ZAG2 in Zagreb's Jankomir district near existing ZAG1; land acquisition announced in 2023 press release; no capacity or permits public yet - grade B.

name: A1 Hrvatska Zagreb data center
notes: A1 opened its Tier III (Uptime) data center in Novi Zagreb at the intersection of Avenija Veceslava Holjevca and Neziceva in Q3 2021; EUR 11m investment, 2,000 sqm, Vertiv build, two 2 MW power branches and 300 IT cabinets per trade press; official A1 page confirms certified data center/colocation services; capacity kept null (power-branch figures are feed design, not verified IT load).

name: Hrvatski Telekom Zagreb data center (Selska/Remete)
notes: Uptime Institute lists HT Data Center Zagreb (opened 2014 at Selska, Zagreb); Siemens 2026-02 blog describes AI-controlled cooling modernization of Croatia's largest telecom data center; telco-owned facility counted as a named physical DC, capacity not published.

name: SRCE / HR-ZOO Zagreb 2 data center
developer: University Computing Centre, University of Zagreb (SRCE)
notes: SRCE opened a new HR-ZOO infrastructure data center at Josipa Marohnica 5, Zagreb (June 2023) for research and higher-education computing; official university source.

name: DataBox Zagreb-Zitnjak data center
notes: DataBox official page markets a purpose-built Tier 3/4-claim data center in Zagreb's Zitnjak industrial zone with 2 MW available power and 2N reliability, colocation and cloud services; DCD reported DataBox took over Digital Realty's Croatia cloud-service business (distinct facility from ZAG1); capacity is operator-claimed available power.

name: Data Target Buzin data center (Comping)
notes: Directory sources place Data Target Buzin in the Zagreb area with about 500 kW; Comping markets associated data-center services; county assignment may straddle Zagreb City/Velika Gorica boundary - kept under Zagreb City per directory listing, aggregate-grade.

name: Akton Zagreb data center
notes: Akton offers data-center services in Zagreb; capacity not published in accessible primary material; directory-confirmed Zagreb facility, aggregate-grade.

name: Croatian Web Hosting / CROWEB.HOST Zagreb data center
notes: Official page states a Tier 3-designed (N+1) data center in Zagreb, 15 km from Zagreb Airport; Baxtel lists it as one of only two Tier III facilities in Croatia alongside A1; capacity not disclosed.

name: PCK Zitnjak data center (planned)
notes: PCK official site: third planned data center on Radnicka Street in eastern Zagreb near the city center and airport (Zitnjak), to be built to Tier 4 standards; no capacity or construction timeline public.

name: Cloudflare Zagreb edge data center
notes: Cloudflare official blog announced a Zagreb data center/PoP (2017); counted as operational CDN/network edge infrastructure rather than commercial colocation; retained for completeness with classification note.
